chunks: That which is in the foot and the big toe: The wergild of the big toe is one-third of the wergild of the leg, being three hundred and thirty-three dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of the breaking of the bone of the big toe which is adjacent to the foot is one-fifth of the wergild of the big toe, being sixty-six dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and regarding the displacement of its bone is twenty-six dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and regarding its fracture is twenty-six dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and regarding its fracture is twenty-six dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and regarding its exposure is eighty dinars and one-third of a dinar; and regarding its piercing is eighty dinars and one-third of a dinar; and regarding its disjointing is ten dinars;

And the wergild of the upper joint of the big toe, and it is the second one in which is the nail, is sixteen dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and regarding its exposure is four dinars and one-sixth; and regarding the displacement of its bone is eight dinars and one-third of a dinar; and regarding its piercing is four dinars and one-sixth; and regarding its fracture is thirteen dinars and one-third of a dinar; and regarding its disjointing is five dinars; and regarding its nail is thirty dinars, and that is because it is one-third of the wergild of the leg;

And the wergild of the toes: The wergild of each toe from it is one-sixth of the wergild of the leg, being three and eighty dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of the bones of the four toes besides the big toe: The wergild of each bone from them is sixteen dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and the wergild of the exposure of the bone of each toe from them is four dinars and one-sixth of a dinar; and the wergild of the displacement of a bone of each of the bones from them is eight dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of its fracture is thirteen dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and the wergild of the piercing of each bone from them is four dinars and one-sixth of a dinar; and the wergild of a wound that does not heal in the foot is three and thirty dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of the breaking of each joint from the four toes which are adjacent to the foot is sixteen dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of its fracture is thirteen dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of the displacement of a bone of each bone from them is eight dinars and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of the exposure of each bone from them is four dinars and one-sixth of a dinar; and the wergild of its piercing is four dinars and one-sixth of a dinar; and the wergild of its disjointing is five dinars;

And regarding the middle joint from the four toes, if it is cut off, so its wergild is five and fifty dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and the wergild of its breaking is eleven dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and the wergild of its fracture is eight dinars and four-fifths of a dinar; and the wergild of its exposure is two dinars; and the wergild of the displacement of its bone is five dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and the wergild of its piercing is two dinars and two-thirds of a dinar; and the wergild of its disjointing is three dinars;

And regarding the upper joint from the four toes in which are the nails, if it is cut off, so its wergild is seven and twenty dinars and four-fifths of a dinar; and the wergild of its breaking is five dinars and four-fifths of a dinar; and the wergild of its fracture is four dinars and a fifth of a dinar; and the wergild of its exposure is a dinar and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of the displacement of its bone is two dinars and one-fifth of a dinar; and the wergild of its piercing is a dinar and one-third of a dinar; and the wergild of its disjointing is two dinars and four-fifths of a dinar; and the wergild of each nail is ten dinars.

key_terms.دِيَة: Wergild or blood money compensation for injury or death
key_terms.صَدْع: Fracture or crack in the bone

ai.seo_question: What is the detailed financial compensation (diyah) for injuries to the toes and foot in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This passage from *Al-Kafi* provides a granular breakdown of *diyah* (blood money) for injuries to the foot and toes, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on precise anatomical valuation derived from the Imams. It distinguishes compensation based on the severity and type of injury—such as fracture (*sad'*), bone displacement (*naql*), and joint dislocation (*fakk*)—demonstrating the systematic application of *qisas* and *diyah* principles in personal injury law. The detailed categorization underscores the scholarly tradition of linking physical harm to specific monetary restitution, ensuring equitable compensation in legal disputes.

en.hubeali: (That) which is in the feet and the big toe – Wergild of the big toe is one-third of the wergild of the leg, being three hundred and thirty-three Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of the breaking of the bone of the big toe which emerges from the foot is one-fifth of the wergild of the big toe, being sixty-six Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and regarding the displacement of its bone is twenty-six Dinars and two-third of a Dinar; and regarding its fracture is twenty-six Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and regarding its exposure is eighty Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and regarding its piercing is eighty Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and regarding its disjointing is ten Dinars;

And wergild of the upper joint from the big toe, and it is the second in which is the nail, is sixteen Dinars; and regarding its exposure is four Dinars and one-sixth; and regarding the displacement of its bone is eighty Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and regarding its piercing is four Dinars and one-sixth; and regarding its fracture is thirteen Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and regarding its disjointing is five Dinars; and regarding its nail is thirty Dinars, and that is because it is one-third of the wergild of the leg;

And wergild of the toes – wergild of each toe from it is one-sixth of the wergild of the left, being eighty three Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of the bones of the four toes are equal to the big toe, the wergild from each toe from these is sixteen Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of the exposure of the bone of each of the toe from these is four Dinars and one-sixth of a Dinar; and wergild of the displacement of a bone of each of the bones from these is eighty Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of its fracture is thirteen Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and wergild of the piercing of each bone from these is four Dinars and one-sixth of a Dinar; and wergild of a bruise in the foot which does not get cured is thirty-three Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild for breaking of each joint from the four toes which emerge from the foot is sixteen Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild for its fracture is thirteen Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of the displacement of a bone of each bones from these is eighty Dinars and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild for the exposure of each bone from these is four Dinars and one-sixth of a Dinar; and wergild for its piercing is four Dinars and one-sixth of a Dinar; and wergild for its disjointing is five Dinars;

And regarding the middle joints from the four toes when it is cut-off, so its wergild is fifty-five Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and wergild of the breaking is eleven Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and wergild of its fracture is eighty Dinars and four-fifths of a Dinar; and wergild of its exposure is two Dinars; and wergild of the displacement of its bone is five Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and wergild of its piercing is two Dinars and two-thirds of a Dinar; and wergild of its disjointing is three Dinars;

And regarding the upper joint from the four toes in which are the nails, when it is cut-off, so its wergild is twenty-seven Dinars and four-fifths of a Dinar; and wergild of its breaking is five dinars and four-fifths of a Dinar; and wergild of its fracture is four Dinars and a fifth of a Dinar; and wergild of its exposure is a Dinar and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of the displacement of its bone is two Dinars and one-fifth of a Dinar; and wergild of its piercing is a Dinar and one-third of a Dinar; and wergild of its disjointing is two Dinars and a four-fifths of a Dinar; and wergild of each nail is ten Dinars’.
